summary: Adds a compound option to format() for multi-unit output like "1h 30m", committed as d57cff2. Later work in the same repo documented it and followed up on its output format.
narrative: The conversation began mid-flow with the owner approving a change and asking for tests and a commit. Memory shows the agent had inspected format() in src/index.ts, which had only short and long modes. It added format(ms, { compound: true }), which emits largest-first day, hour, minute and second parts, skips zero parts and is capped at days (obs 3). It was committed as d57cff2 (obs 4). No evidence of a merge or release appears in this conversation. A later conversation documented the option and added tests, and the owner then said the output must be ParseDuration-compatible. So the feature is built but its format is likely to be reworked.

milestones.text: Added compound option to format() for multi-unit output

preferences.preference: Wants tests added and a commit made once a change looks good
preferences.quote: Nice. Add tests for it and commit.
